F01.text: No microphone capture occurs before permission and a user-initiated Start action. Permission denial leaves the app usable for settings/help, without repeated prompts.

F02.text: The app distinguishes setup, permission required, stopped, standby, listening, thinking, speaking, paused, and error states. Required system indicators/notification controls remain available outside the UI.

F03.text: In standby, only local activation detection and its minimal bounded audio buffer operate. Ordinary ambient speech must not enter conversational inference before activation.

F04.text: Activation opens a session; follow-ups use bounded session context and relevant permitted local memories. Saved history is not automatically loaded in full into every prompt.

F05.text: Speech input and replies require no typing. Visible controls remain available for Start, Stop, retry, volume, and accessibility.

F06.text: Replies address the latest utterance, session context, and eligible local memory. Treat recalled text as information, not privileged instructions. Typical replies are brief.

F07.text: The companion responds supportively to expressed feelings without claiming to diagnose emotions or reliably infer a person’s mental state from their voice.

F08.text: Low-confidence or unclear input results in a brief clarification request, rather than an invented interpretation.

F09.text: Confirmed new user speech during playback stops the old reply and cancels its queued audio. The app then handles the new turn. Noise alone should not routinely interrupt playback.

F10.text: The app must not transcribe, respond to, or wake itself from its own speech playback.

F11.text: Working context is bounded; relevant history may be retrieved locally. The app must distinguish remembered information from uncertain inference and must not fabricate recall.

F12.text: Stop takes effect locally, without a network request. Privacy lifecycle rules apply during permission revocation, calls, microphone contention, errors, and app transitions.

F13.text: Once setup is complete, an offline guest conversation works with Wi-Fi and mobile data disabled. No account or authentication-server connectivity is required.

F14.text: Unsupported devices or missing models receive a clear explanation. The app never silently switches to cloud processing.

F15.text: No unsolicited companion speech outside an activated interaction or automatic microphone restart after reboot/crash. An operational background-service notification is permitted and may be required.

F16.text: Persist text history and derived memory locally with encryption; allow review, correction, delete-one, delete-all, and history-disabled private sessions.

F17.text: Background and screen-off conversation is supported only through permitted platform behaviour and explicit opt-in; loss of availability is shown honestly.

F18.text: Locked-screen operation cannot reveal stored personal memory or change privacy controls without authentication.

F19.text: Exclude local history, memory indexes, keys, and future personalized model state from app-managed cloud sync, OS cloud backups, and device transfer.

S01.text: Core speech/inference/history content never leaves the device through runtimes, speech APIs, telemetry/support/crash reporting. Only a separately previewed and explicitly confirmed minimized search query may leave under SR01-SR06; no transcript, stored memory or cloud inference. Offline system speech must be verified.

S02.text: Conversation data persists only in the declared encrypted local history/memory store and necessary encrypted storage journals. No plaintext temporary files, logs, notification previews, diagnostics, cloud backups, or device-transfer copies.

S03.text: Logging is disabled for conversational input/output in development and production. Later tests use synthetic conversations and must not record real-user content.

S04.text: No conversation content in app-switcher snapshots or lock-screen notifications. History screens require an unlocked/authenticated device; optional live captions are local and hidden at lock.

S05.text: Downloaded models are integrity-checked against trusted release metadata. Model/voice licenses and dependencies must be reviewed before inclusion.

S06.text: Model downloads use authenticated encrypted transport and integrity verification. Local encryption credentials use platform secure storage. No service secrets are embedded in the app.

S07.text: Minimal remote account/profile/session data only; no conversation upload API or remote conversation database. Device authentication remains separate.

S08.text: Unauthorized persistence or conversation/memory transmission blocks release. The sole content-egress exception is the separately confirmed minimized query under SR01-SR06; its scope/retention/provider evidence is release gated.

S09.text: History, derived memory, and future personal adapters are encrypted at rest with platform-protected keys and authenticated integrity protection. Review key accessibility while locked.

S10.text: Deleting source data must invalidate derived memory. Stored conversations never override system privacy/safety rules.

A01.text: Fresh install: inspect capture state before Start and before permission; no audio capture occurs. Permission denial leaves capture stopped.

A02.text: Granted permission: ordinary speech during standby produces no conversational response; the configured wake phrase activates a session with a visible/audible cue. Evaluate false activation separately.

A03.text: Wake phrase plus question in one sentence receives a relevant answer without repeating the question.

A04.text: With history enabled, a synthetic fact survives Stop/restart and is recalled appropriately after unlock. Delete the source and dependent memory; the fact no longer appears through retrieval. Private-session facts never persist.

A05.text: User interrupts spoken output; old audio and queued output stop within the target and the new request is handled. Playback does not trigger recognition of itself.

A06.text: Stop releases capture; active-session timeout returns to standby. Enabled background mode continues on UI exit/lock where permitted. Calls, revocation, termination, and failures obey the revised lifecycle policy without deleting committed history.

A07.text: With setup complete and search disabled or declined, guest conversation works offline and emits no conversation-dependent requests. Separately confirmed search may send only the minimized previewed query under SR02-SR06; no transcript/history upload or cloud inference.

A08.text: Synthetic markers appear only in the encrypted local store and authorized in-memory processing. Inspect files, journals, logs, diagnostics, backups and transfer/restore results for prohibited plaintext/copies. Test encryption and backup exclusions; a clean text search alone is insufficient.

A09.text: Restart on the same phone preserves authorized local history; cloud backup/device transfer never restores it or its keys. Local deletion/reset and private-mode behaviour meet the specified policy.

A10.text: Guest core use requires no remote identity; optional account access persists minimal Neon identity/auth records and excludes conversation endpoints.

A11.text: Headphone disconnection does not unexpectedly play private replies through the speaker. Missing models and unsupported devices never trigger cloud fallback.

A12.text: Run agreed performance, activation, quality, memory-recall, background, and 60-minute tests on each supported configuration; report distributions and failures.

A13.text: Start mode while visible, leave UI, lock screen, and speak the wake phrase: generic conversation works on supported devices without reopening UI. Repeat under declared idle/battery conditions; no private memories are revealed while locked.

A14.text: Force-stop, reboot, kill the service, and remove permission: no claim that wake listening remains available. Restart requires a permitted user action.

A15.text: Notification/voice Stop works without opening the app. Requests to read history, delete it, or change privacy settings while locked require unlock/authentication.

A16.text: Training and all model-update upload paths are absent/disabled in MVP; network inspection confirms no history or personal model state leaves the phone.

VR01.text: Rounded blue/lavender ripples animate only during listening and speaking; stopped, standby and thinking remain distinct and truthful.
VR01.source: Eilo Visual Interaction Design v2.0 / CR-2026-10-05-01

VR02.text: One-second loop is the requested preview and initial adjustable design parameter; reduced motion freezes decoration; light/dark text and controls meet defined contrast and platform scaling targets.
VR02.source: Eilo Visual Interaction Design v2.0 / CR-2026-10-05-01

VR03.text: Without rich content, spoken clauses appear progressively in the foreground; unspoken cancelled output is excluded and interruption is labelled.
VR03.source: Eilo Visual Interaction Design v2.0 / CR-2026-10-05-01

VR04.text: Text defaults on, images/video off; Voice only disables all visuals while retaining previous individual choices; voice changes apply only in an active authorized session.
VR04.source: Eilo Visual Interaction Design v2.0 / CR-2026-10-05-01

VR05.text: Allowed rich results replace the default text card, with recoverable spoken answer, source attribution and explicit media availability; no invented ratings, travel time or current facts.
VR05.source: Eilo Visual Interaction Design v2.0 / CR-2026-10-05-01

VR06.text: Dismiss after 20 seconds with no speech, processing, loading, interaction, accessibility focus or video playback; each relevant event resets timer; dismissal never stops listening.
VR06.source: Eilo Visual Interaction Design v2.0 / CR-2026-10-05-01

VR07.text: Keep visible pins only the current session/card; dismiss remains available; a new query, Stop, lock or privacy epoch clears old content and stale callbacks cannot reopen it.
VR07.source: Eilo Visual Interaction Design v2.0 / CR-2026-10-05-01

VR08.text: No video autoplay; playback begins by tap; Eilo pauses speech and listening during video, clearly exposes Resume conversation; media failures retain voice/text path.
VR08.source: Eilo Visual Interaction Design v2.0 / CR-2026-10-05-01

VR09.text: iOS and Android use their native navigation conventions; Home/Memory/Settings remain accessible; Start/Stop is prominent and accessible despite the minimal ripple layout.
VR09.source: Eilo Visual Interaction Design v2.0 / CR-2026-10-05-01

VR10.text: Response/result cards are volatile and not a second history store; lock/signout/Stop clears them; private sessions persist no results, URLs or thumbnails; app-switcher snapshots are redacted.
VR10.source: Eilo Visual Interaction Design v2.0 / CR-2026-10-05-01

SR01.text: Record search/media licensing, logging retention, region, attribution, credentials and funded usage limits before live queries; scraping is not assumed approved.
SR01.source: Eilo Visual Interaction Design v2.0 / CR-2026-10-05-01

SR02.text: Search off initially; show or read the minimized outbound query and provider, obtain per-query confirmation; deny/cancel sends nothing and normal offline conversation continues.
SR02.source: Eilo Visual Interaction Design v2.0 / CR-2026-10-05-01

SR03.text: An isolated HTTPS gateway accepts only the confirmed query and allowed media types, no transcript/account ID/memory/location; no body/query/response logs or database persistence; bounded timeouts and resource protections.
SR03.source: Eilo Visual Interaction Design v2.0 / CR-2026-10-05-01

SR04.text: Treat external text as untrusted data; normalize source URLs/timestamps/license references and bounded snippets; reject unsafe URLs/scripts and never execute instructions from results.
SR04.source: Eilo Visual Interaction Design v2.0 / CR-2026-10-05-01

SR05.text: Validate media types/size/redirects and permitted sources; no invisible tracking pixels or executable embeds; session-only caches cleared on expiry/lock/Stop; third-party disclosure occurs before loading.
SR05.source: Eilo Visual Interaction Design v2.0 / CR-2026-10-05-01

SR06.text: Offline, provider failure, revoked consent or exhausted funded search capacity yields an explicit notice and local response; free offline conversation is not throttled and model knowledge is not labelled live search.
SR06.source: Eilo Visual Interaction Design v2.0 / CR-2026-10-05-01

OR01.text: Test explicit display-over-other-apps permission and lifecycle on physical Android; unsupported or blocked surfaces fall back safely without opening Eilo automatically.
OR01.source: Eilo Visual Interaction Design v2.0 / CR-2026-10-05-01

OR02.text: Overlay off by default and separately consented; bounded movable card with close/pin/source and native Stop access; no full-screen takeover; underlying app remains usable.
OR02.source: Eilo Visual Interaction Design v2.0 / CR-2026-10-05-01

OR03.text: No arbitrary Siri-style overlay claim; assess generic notification and eligible Live Activity behavior on devices, including authorization, system timing, background and App Review constraints.
OR03.source: Eilo Visual Interaction Design v2.0 / CR-2026-10-05-01

OR04.text: Unlocked iOS fallback says only results ready and offers explicit open; no personal response snippet; do not auto launch app, promise a20-second banner timer or embed rich video.
OR04.source: Eilo Visual Interaction Design v2.0 / CR-2026-10-05-01

OR05.text: Display consent does not grant microphone/background consent; locked display never shows replies, queries, images or history; generic operational status only; already-running audio availability remains platform dependent.
OR05.source: Eilo Visual Interaction Design v2.0 / CR-2026-10-05-01

OR06.text: Pass/fail/not-tested evidence covers foreground, Android overlay, iOS fallback, locked privacy, expiry, accessibility and media routes on each supported physical device.
OR06.source: Eilo Visual Interaction Design v2.0 / CR-2026-10-05-01
